name: FinTrack
summary: FinTrack is a full-stack personal finance management application that helps users efficiently manage their financial activities. The application enables users to track income, expenses, budgets, multiple accounts, and recurring transactions while providing detailed financial analytics through an interactive dashboard. The project was built to provide users with a secure, scalable, and user-friendly platform for managing personal finances.
problem_statement: Many people struggle to manage their daily expenses, monthly budgets, and savings using spreadsheets or manual records. Existing solutions are often complicated or contain unnecessary features. FinTrack was developed to provide a simple, secure, and modern finance management system that allows users to organize their financial data in one place.
objectives: Provide a secure personal finance management system.

relationships: One User can own multiple Accounts.
One User can create multiple Budgets.

workflow: User registers or logs into the application.
JWT token is generated after successful authentication.
Frontend uses the JWT token for protected requests.
Backend validates the token before processing protected requests.
Users can manage budgets, transactions, accounts, and categories.
Financial data is displayed through the analytics dashboard.
my_contributions: Developed REST APIs using Spring Boot.
Implemented budget and transaction management modules.
challenges: Handling CORS between frontend and backend.
solutions: Used JPA and Hibernate to manage entity relationships.
Configured CORS between the frontend and backend.
Separated application logic into appropriate backend layers.
learnings: Building scalable backend applications using Spring Boot.
future_improvements: Export reports as PDF and Excel.
resume_description: Developed a production-style full-stack personal finance management application using Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and JWT authentication.
